text:
Sam: ok important: I asked an LLM to write adoption profiles for our favorite open models as if they were office pets. the results are terrifyingly cute. :dog:

Sam: Prompt I used: ```Write a 2-sentence adoption profile for each model listed (funny, wholesome), like they're office pets up for adoption: Falcon-7B, Llama2-13B, Mistral-7B, Polyglot-2.```

Priya: please share, this is a cute way to pick our team mascot :heart_eyes:

Sam: Falcon-7B: "Name: Falcon. Likes: dramatic one-liners, fast fetch sessions. Needs a calm human for late-night debugging and snacks on demand."

Elliot: hahahaha "fast fetch sessions" is peak inference culture :joy:

Sam: Llama2-13B: "Name: Llama. Likes: long, thorough notes and organized snacks. Will remind you of missing PR reviewers and bring spreadsheets to cuddle."

Marta: omg that's my spirit animal. we should give it a tiny clipboard. :clipboard:

Sam: Mistral-7B: "Name: Mistral. Likes: sprint races, espresso, and tiny hats. Best at pep talks before demos, but may nap on your keyboard."

Priya: tiny hats for Mistral. we should craft tiny racer helmets.

Sam: Polyglot-2: "Name: Poly. Likes: saying hello in three accents and stealing snacks politely. Fluent in small talk and puns; will learn your favorite coffee order."

Elliot: vote: which model pet should be our official office mascot? React with :tada: Falcon, :llama: Llama (pretend emoji), :coffee: Mistral, :earth_africa: Polyglot.

Marta: also opsbot can you make a tiny voting poll? @opsbot

opsbot: @Marta Sure. Poll created: "Choose office mascot" Options: Falcon, Llama, Mistral, Polyglot. Reply with the option text to vote.

Priya: Falcon

Elliot: Polyglot

Marta: Llama

Sam: Mistral (tiny hat incoming)

opsbot: Poll results: Falcon 1, Llama 1, Mistral 1, Polyglot 1. It's a tie! Suggestion: mascot round-robin (each week a different model pet).

Priya: round-robin it is. also challenge: someone turn the Falcon blurb into a tiny plush design prompt for the next hackday.

Elliot: I'll try. bonus if the plush has a clip-on tiny clipboard.

Marta: this thread is exactly the morale boost Friday afternoon needed. thanks AI culture team. :sparkles:
